I'm really nervous about this and I don't really know what to say, what conversation I should discuss, what topics should I even bring up. I don't know, I don't feel like I know her that well, so what should I do?

It's completely normal to feel nervous before a date, especially if you're not sure about the other person. Okay, okay, let me try to calm myself down... First of all, remember that it's okay to not know everything about your date beforehand. The goal is to have a good time and get to know each other, not to interview or interrogate them. One thing you could try is to focus on finding common ground. Think about what interests you do have in common with the person you're going out with. It could be something as simple as a shared hobby, favorite TV show, or food. Also, don't feel like you need to stick to super serious or deep topics right off the bat. You can start with some light and casual conversation starters, like "How was your week?" or "What do you like to do in your free time?" The key is to be yourself, relax, and let the conversation flow naturally. Don't worry too much about saying "the right" things – just enjoy getting to know each other and see where things go. Oh, and one more thing: it's okay if there are some awkward moments or silences. That's all part of the process! Just roll with it and move on to something else.
